independentWork: For f(t)=t^2+6t+8=(t+2)(t+4), f(t)≥0 requires t≤−4 or t≥−2. Since g is an upward-opening quadratic with range [a+10−a^2/4,∞), its range cannot lie in t≤−4 because it is unbounded above; therefore its minimum must be at least −2. This gives a^2−4a−48≤0, hence 2−2√13≤a≤2+2√13 and pq=−48.
